calendarSlots.title: Calendar free-slot scheduler
calendarSlots.description: Starts new auto-run work only in your Google Calendar free time (times only — event titles and attendees are never read).
calendarSlots.loadFailed: Failed to load calendar slot data
calendarSlots.noFreeSlot: No free time within the fetched range
calendarSlots.runningPhaseNote: A running phase is never force-stopped; it stops at the phase boundary. If it cannot reach that boundary before the meeting, it may keep running during the meeting.
calendarSlots.failOpenNote: Calendar data is unavailable, so auto-run is not held by the calendar.

action.phase_held: Running task held at a phase checkpoint
action.phase_released: Resumed from the phase checkpoint after the meeting
